offering_description.value: Sells cloud software and data for auto insurance claims, including estimating, total loss valuation and repair management, to insurers, repair shops and auto manufacturers. Earns money mainly through subscriptions and per-transaction fees.

primary_products.value: claims management software; vehicle valuation data; repair estimating software; parts and repair data

primary_services.value: claims network connectivity; analytics and consulting; repair shop management services

customer_segment.value: B2B: auto insurers, collision repair shops, auto manufacturers, parts suppliers

end_markets.value: auto insurance; collision repair; automotive manufacturing; automotive aftermarket

revenue_model.value: subscription: software subscriptions paid by insurers and repair shops; transaction or usage fees: per-claim and per-transaction fees for data and network use

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud platform connecting insurers, repair shops and parts suppliers; service provider: claims and repair services sold to insurers and collision shops

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with smaller operations in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: claims software, valuation data, repair estimating and network services sharing auto insurance customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to large insurers and repair networks; online: cloud software accessed by customers over the internet

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules for vehicle and personal claims data
